name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Toggles joined on the segmented control's gray track, the pressed ones as white keys; an outline variant joins outline keys.
usage: Choose one (type="single") or several (type="multiple") view options that belong together (text alignment, which APIs a chart shows, a request's formats). For a form value with one answer, SegmentedControl's gliding pill is the closer match.
avoid: Mixing icon-only and labelled items without aria-labels

reference.source: context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/form.tsx (SegmentedControl, segmented); extended to several pressed items
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
